name: @youdotcom-oss/n8n-nodes-youdotcom
description: n8n community node for You.com APIs - Search, Contents extraction, and Express AI agent

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: cp nodes/YouDotCom/youdotcom.svg dist/nodes/YouDotCom/ && cp nodes/YouDotCom/YouDotCom.node.json dist/nodes/YouDotCom/ && cp nodes/YouDotCom/youdotcom.svg dist/credentials/
scripts.build:js: bun build ./nodes/YouDotCom/YouDotCom.node.ts --outfile ./dist/nodes/YouDotCom/YouDotCom.node.js --target=node --external n8n-workflow && bun build ./credentials/YouDotComApi.credentials.ts --outfile ./dist/credentials/YouDotComApi.credentials.js --target=node --external n8n-workflow
scripts.check: bun run check:biome && bun run check:types && bun run check:package
